title: Epistemology
learning_outcomes: Explain belief truth and justification in the context of epistemology.
Compare and distinguish testimony in the context of epistemology.
Apply theories of knowledge in the context of epistemology.
Evaluate and justify decisions about confidence in the context of epistemology.

lessons.title: Belief truth and justification
lessons.outcome: Explain belief truth and justification in the context of epistemology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving belief truth and justification; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to epistemic audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain belief truth and justification from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of belief truth and justification; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Testimony
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish testimony in the context of epistemology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving testimony; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to epistemic audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain testimony from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of testimony; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Theories of knowledge
lessons.outcome: Apply theories of knowledge in the context of epistemology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving theories of knowledge; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to epistemic audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain theories of knowledge from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of theories of knowledge; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Confidence
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about confidence in the context of epistemology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving confidence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to epistemic audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain confidence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of confidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of belief truth and justification; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of testimony; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of theories of knowledge; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of confidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
